Reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
reached_sql:
WITH eligible_item AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        i_manager_id,
        i_item_sk,
        i_category,
        i_class,
        i_brand
    FROM item
    WHERE (
        i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Electronics')
        AND i_class IN ('personal', 'portable', 'reference', 'self-help')
        AND i_brand IN (
            'scholaramalgamalg #14',
            'scholaramalgamalg #7',
            'exportiunivamalg #9',
            'scholaramalgamalg #9'
        )
    )
    OR (
        i_category IN ('Women', 'Music', 'Men')
        AND i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants')
        AND i_brand IN (
            'amalgimporto #1',
            'edu packscholar #1',
            'exportiimporto #1',
            'importoamalg #1'
        )
    )
),
tmp1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        ei.i_manager_id,
        SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales,
        AVG(SUM(ss.ss_sales_price)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ei.i_manager_id
        ) AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM eligible_item AS ei
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            ss_item_sk,
            ss_sold_date_sk,
            ss_store_sk,
            ss_sales_price
        FROM store_sales
        WHERE ss_item_sk = ei.i_item_sk
    ) AS ss
        ON ss.ss_item_sk = ei.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim AS dd
        ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
       AND dd.d_month_seq IN (
            1222,
            1222 + 1,
            1222 + 2,
            1222 + 3,
            1222 + 4,
            1222 + 5,
            1222 + 6,
            1222 + 7,
            1222 + 8,
            1222 + 9,
            1222 + 10,
            1222 + 11
       )
    JOIN store AS st
        ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY ei.i_manager_id, dd.d_moy
)
SELECT
    i_manager_id,
    sum_sales,
    avg_monthly_sales
FROM tmp1
WHERE CASE
    WHEN avg_monthly_sales > 0
        THEN ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) / avg_monthly_sales
    ELSE NULL
END > 0.1
ORDER BY i_manager_id, avg_monthly_sales, sum_sales
LIMIT 100
